extractor: read from the page registered in source_roles, fetched from the VPS with the source monitor's own User-Agent
policy: Every entry quotes the official page it was read from, verbatim and in English. This is the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' published fee schedule; the Ministry of Interior decides entry and holds the eligibility detail on hosts that serve navigation shells or refuse us.
structure_note:
THIS ROUTE PUBLISHES WHAT A VISA COSTS AND NOT WHO QUALIFIES FOR IT, and that inversion is unusual enough to state plainly. Qatar's MFA lists seven visa types with QAR amounts and then sends the reader to www.moi.gov.qa for everything else — and portal.moi.gov.qa serves 70KB of markup carrying under 2,000 characters, 85% of it shared between sibling pages, while hukoomi.gov.qa returns HTTP 403 despite robots.txt permitting the path.

Note also WHICH applications this covers: the Consular Affairs Department handles cases that cannot be applied for through the electronic visa system. It is the exception channel, not the main one.
freshness_note: The page publishes no dateModified in its markup and no body dateline; reported as unknown, never as fresh. Source language is English.
not_extracted: Who qualifies for any of the seven visa types. The page publishes the fee schedule and refers all detail to www.moi.gov.qa, whose portal serves navigation shells.
